subject: Scope & fee transition: MSA change control and SOW consolidation
messages:
From: Danielle Park <dpark@orchardhealth.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Orchard Procurement <procure@orchardhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redlines + scope ask (initial)

Hi Rachel / Karthik —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, we're proposing two coordinated changes: (1) a formal change control to increase committed capacity across Q3–Q4, and (2) consolidation of the SOW exhibits to reflect the new integration plan (Exhibit C). I attached our marked-up MSA with inline comments (Orchard_MSA_redline_v2.docx) and the draft Exhibit C PDF.

Key asks from procurement/legal:
- Confirmation of the process (change order vs amendment) you'd prefer for adding committed GPUs and any impact to the fee schedule.
- A clean SOW that merges the current Exhibit B + C into a single Implementation SOW (we gave suggested language in the PDF).
- Rough cost/time impact estimate so we can get this in our FY28 approval packet (deadline: 2028-04-07).

Can you confirm an internal owner for the commercial redlines vs legal redlines and whether Redwood can provide a one-page summary of price deltas (monthly committed fees + proration approach)?

Attachments: Orchard_MSA_redline_v2.docx (comments), SOW-Implementation-ExhibitC.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
Danielle Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Orchard Health

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Danielle Park <dpark@orchardhealth.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines + scope ask (initial)

Danielle —

Appreciate the clear packet and the redlines. Quick notes from our side after a rapid review:

1) Process: We typically handle capacity increases via a Change Order appended to the existing MSA (keeps master terms intact). For material commercial adjustments we include an "Exhibit — Fee Schedule" update plus a consolidated SOW attachment.

2) Owners: I will lead commercial coordination (pricing, PO cadence) and loop in Karthik for the change order draft. Laura (legal) and Marissa (contracts) are CC'd and will own the legal redline responses / DocuSign flow.

3) Timing: We can provide a one-page delta summary and a draft Change Order by EOD 2028-03-29. If Orchard needs it earlier for packet inclusion, tell me which line items are time-sensitive and we’ll prioritize.

4) Proration approach: our standard for mid-quarter top-ups is a prorated monthly commitment + an end-of-term reconciliation clause. If Orchard prefers a flat pro-rata credit instead, we can model both.

Next steps:
- Karthik: can you draft the initial Change Order skeleton (capacity + fee smoothing proposal)?
- Laura / Marissa: please advise if there are any clauses in Orchard_MSA_redline_v2 that are non-starters for Redwood (we'll mark them inline).

Danielle — I’ll follow up with the one-pager and a proposed effective date (target: 2028-04-01 for the change order).

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Danielle Park <dpark@orchardhealth.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Mar 2028 10:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines + scope ask (initial) — draft Change Order attached

Danielle / Rachel —

Thanks — I've put together a draft Change Order (attached as the proposed path). High level summary:
- Change Order A: adds 200 committed GPU-hours/month (phased: +100 effective 2028-04-01, additional +100 effective 2028-07-01)
- Fee approach: blended rate for the additional capacity across the quarter to limit step-up shock; line-item shows a monthly proration for Apr/May/Jun with an end-of-year reconciliation to true-up usage vs committed.
- SOW consolidation: we've taken the Exhibit C draft and inlined the integration milestones into a single Implementation SOW (see section 2.1–2.4).

I've flagged two commercial questions inline where Orchard redlines requested non-standard indemnity language and an expanded data retention schedule — Laura/Marissa, see {Comment-#3} and {Comment-#7} in the attached.

If this aligns, I can convert the Change Order to DocuSign-ready PDF and route for signatures. If Orchard procurement confirms the PO cadence (monthly vs quarterly invoice) we can put the costs into a PO-ready table.

Attachment referenced: SOW-Implementation-ExhibitC.pdf (reconciled)

Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Danielle Park <dpark@orchardhealth.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines + scope ask (initial) — next steps and exec approval path

Danielle —

Following internal review, we're aligned on the Change Order route. A couple of notes from contracts/legal:

- Non-starter items: the requested broadening of the indemnity clause and the annualized unlimited retention for debug logs are not acceptable as written. Laura will propose specific language that addresses Orchard's concern while preserving Redwood's commercial risk posture.
- Signature flow: we'll prepare a single Change Order + consolidated SOW packet and send via DocuSign. Target routing: Rachel (Commercial approval) -> Orchards signatory -> Redwood Exec approval (Marissa) -> finalize.
- PO & billing: to keep your approval packet clean, Rachel can provide the one-page price delta (line-item monthly $) and Karthik will include the proration model. We recommend Orchard issue a short-form PO referencing Change Order A once your legal team signs off; that will unlock invoicing ASAP.

Action items and owners:
- Laura: redline responses & proposed indemnity text (deliverable: 2028-03-31 EOB)
- Karthik: convert the Change Order to DocuSign-ready PDF & populate PO table (deliverable: 2028-03-31 EOB)
- Rachel: one-page price delta summary for Orchard FY28 packet (deliverable: 2028-03-30 noon PT)

Danielle — if Orchard legal confirms they can accept the proposed constrained indemnity and the data retention carveout, we should be able to complete signatures by 2028-04-04 and align invoicing for the 2028-04-01 effective tranche. Please confirm if the PO cadence is monthly or quarterly so Karthik can finalize the table.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Contracts & Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
